technical_and_design_decisions: Use the existing build, test, benchmark, and documentation conventions in the repository rather than introducing new frameworks.

Implement U1 as repeatable benchmark configurations for baseline, Tuple, and Serialized payloads across the specified In-Memory Transport to HDFS, Direct Binding Transport to HDFS, and Kafka to HDFS paths.
Upgrade Reactor to version 2.0.3 through the repository's dependency management, then resolve API or behavioral incompatibilities rather than maintaining parallel Reactor versions.
Make JMX disabled by default through the existing XD configuration mechanism while preserving an explicit configuration option to enable it.
Fix Gradle dist and distZip tasks with minimal changes to existing packaging and publication behavior.
Support multiple container instances by parameterizing RPM service configuration, instance identity, ports, directories, and process metadata while preserving the existing single-instance invocation.
Update documentation using the existing documentation structure and navigation conventions, including links to OOTB batch jobs and analytics widget guidance.
Use automated unit, integration, packaging, and smoke tests where existing test infrastructure supports them; use repeatable manual verification for benchmark execution and documentation navigation.
Treat performance comparison results as reproducibility artifacts and configuration validation, not as a requirement to guarantee a specific performance improvement.
assumptions: The existing Spring XD source repository, Gradle build, RPM packaging scripts, benchmark or sample infrastructure, and documentation source are available and buildable with Java 17 or the version required by the target branch.
The requested increment is applied to an existing codebase with established CI and test conventions; no new deployment platform or major architectural component is required.
The exact baseline and 0.8.1 versus 0.8.2 Kafka environments are available or can be represented by existing dependency and configuration profiles.

U1 requires implementing or correcting repeatable benchmark scenarios and validating that they can be rerun; it does not require a statistically rigorous long-duration performance study or production-scale data generation.
Existing HDFS, Kafka, transport, and sink test infrastructure can be reused, with local or mocked services used where appropriate for development verification.
Reactor 2.0.3 is compatible with the target Java and Spring XD codebase except for limited compilation, API, or test adjustments.
JMX currently has a centralized or sufficiently discoverable configuration point, so disabling it by default does not require redesigning the management subsystem.
The Gradle distribution fixes are limited to the existing dist and distZip targets and their immediate dependencies; publishing to an external repository is not included.
Compiler and Javadoc warnings can be cleaned up without changing public behavior, except for minor source, annotation, or documentation corrections.

RPM scripts are expected to run multiple instances on one host with operator-supplied instance identifiers and nonconflicting ports and directories; full orchestration and cluster discovery are out of scope.
U7 and U8 require documentation content, cross-references, and navigation updates, not a redesign of the documentation site or analytics user interface.

Effort includes implementation, code review preparation, local validation, and defect correction by one developer, but excludes elapsed waiting time for external teams, infrastructure provisioning, and release management.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing modules, dependency declarations, benchmark configurations, JMX configuration, Gradle distribution tasks, warning output, RPM scripts, tests, and documentation structure. Establish the change map and local validation approach for all eight user stories.

activities.activity_name: Kafka payload and sink benchmark support
activities.activity_description: Add or correct repeatable benchmark scenarios for baseline, Tuple, and Serialized payloads across In-Memory Transport to HDFS, Direct Binding Transport to HDFS, and Kafka to HDFS. Include required configuration, data setup, execution scripts or instructions, and result capture.

Run the benchmark scenarios against the relevant Kafka 0.8.1 and 0.8.2 configurations, verify that all payload and sink combinations execute successfully, investigate failures, and record comparable output and usage notes.

Update Reactor dependency declarations and transitive dependency handling, compile affected modules, resolve API or behavioral incompatibilities, and update dependency-related tests or configuration as needed.

Change the default XD configuration so JMX is off, preserve an explicit opt-in mechanism, update configuration metadata or documentation, and add or adjust tests confirming both disabled-default and enabled-explicit behavior.

Diagnose and fix the outstanding local ./gradlew dist and distZip failures, correct packaging inputs or task dependencies, and verify that generated distributions contain the expected artifacts and can be used for publish-build evaluation.

Collect warning output from the relevant build targets, correct compiler warnings, resolve Javadoc errors and warnings, adjust annotations or documentation where appropriate, and repeat builds to confirm the targeted warning cleanup.

activities.activity_name: RPM support for multiple XD container instances
activities.activity_description: Modify RPM installation, configuration, startup, shutdown, and service-script behavior to accept distinct container instance identities and avoid conflicts in ports, PID files, logs, work directories, and configuration paths while retaining single-instance compatibility.

Build or install the RPM locally, start and stop multiple container instances on one node, verify isolation and lifecycle behavior, test failure and restart paths, and correct packaging or script defects found during validation.

activities.activity_name: OOTB batch job documentation and navigation
activities.activity_description: Document or organize references to out-of-the-box batch jobs, add links from the appropriate documentation entry points, verify anchors and navigation, and ensure each referenced job has usable details.

Add documentation for the analytics tab and the available streaming-pipeline widgets, including purpose, setup or usage context, and navigation links. Validate examples and rendered documentation where tooling permits.

Run the relevant unit and integration test suites after dependency, configuration, build, packaging, and script changes; perform distribution and smoke-build checks; fix regressions attributable to the increment.

activities.activity_name: Final change review and delivery preparation
activities.activity_description: Review the complete change set for consistency, update release or change notes where required, confirm reproducibility of the principal commands and scenarios, and prepare the increment for handoff.
